Create ONE beautiful realistic adult woman portrait, about 25 years old, STRICTLY STRAIGHT FRONT VIEW, completely bald with no hair or stubble, with all facial features present and anatomically coherent. Use the attached images ONLY as references for the polished realistic game-character art quality and the attractive adult feminine anatomy. They are not edit targets. We are restarting the anatomy from scratch: do not imitate any earlier generated bald head or atlas. NO atlas, ONE complete normal human face.
Camera is at eye level, neutral head pose with absolutely no yaw, pitch or roll; both ears equally visible; nose directly on midline; relaxed neutral expression; eyes focus on camera. Long portrait lens with negligible perspective distortion. A believable elegant adult female face, subtle oval silhouette, natural cheekbones and mandible tapering smoothly to a softly rounded chin; natural size almond eyes, hazel-green irises, subtle natural brows, a straight refined nose, closed gently full dusty rose lips. Pale warm beige skin, understated realistic skin microtexture, very light freckles at most, no exaggerated pores or blotches. Soft studio key light slightly above and left, gentle frontal fill; restrained shadows. Match the sophisticated CGI realism of the attached women, not anime, cartoon, beauty-filter doll, collage or mannequin.
Composition: square image, full bald skull clearly visible with comfortable margin above and at sides, entire face and short upper neck. Shoulders and torso outside frame; no clothes, no collars, no accessories. Solid dark charcoal blue background #1C2836. Head should occupy approximately 76% of canvas height from crown to chin and about 51% of canvas width across cheekbones. Centered face. Neck exits at bottom. No hair.
Use these anatomical drawing principles to maintain adult proportions rather than blindly enforcing exact beauty formulas: eye line approximately halfway between crown and chin; conceptual hairline-to-brow, brow-to-nasal-base, nasal-base-to-chin are approximately equal thirds; eyes separated by roughly one eye fissure width; face about five eye fissure widths across; nose wings roughly align with inner eye corners; lips approximately 1.5 to 1.8 nose widths; mouth slit in upper third of nose-to-chin interval; ears run approximately brow to nasal base. These are guidelines with subtle lifelike variation. Skull not tall or swollen; eyes not giant or far apart; chin not flat cut, triangular or infantile; neck naturally narrower than jaw.
Indicative normalized layout in canvas (not labels to draw): crown y0.10, chin y0.86, eyes y0.48, brows y0.42, nasal base y0.64, mouth slit y0.715; midline x0.50, pupils about x0.40 and0.60. Keep natural integrated anatomy over rigid geometry. Absolutely no guides, writing, diagrams or grid. Output only the finished beautiful bald woman head portrait.
